banner: PROPOSED FOR RATIFICATION. This package is prepared for a decision by an authorized product owner. It is not a ratified canonical, not the recovered historical canonical and not an institutional authorization. Engineering cannot accept it.

lineage.statement: UE-FINANCIAL-OFFICER-CANONICAL-2.1 is cited by a frozen disposition and its text was not recovered. This package is a reconstruction candidate built from the proposed baseline and is not that document.

authorityClassLegend.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: A requirement the engineering gates must build or prove. It grants nothing.
authorityClassLegend.IMPLEMENTED_SOURCE_BEHAVIOR: Behavior that source already shows. It is not a statement that the behavior is complete or qualified.
authorityClassLegend.PROPOSED_PERMISSION: A permission proposed for product acceptance that stays inactive until the named institutional decision is adopted.
authorityClassLegend.ADOPTED_INSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORIZATION: Not used. No institutional authorization has been adopted and none can be created by this package.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Identity and eligibility
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: A role title carries no financial authority. Each financial duty needs a live issued mandate or appointment. No financial mandate has been issued and nothing in this package issues one.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Organization and federation scope
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Finance is bounded to the active organization. Affiliate remittances are UNAVAILABLE_501 and the four organization scenarios are hypotheses with no source backing.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Case, member and document visibility
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Balances, member financial records and reports are visible only for the accounts and fields a live mandate names. A view duty does not carry a report, member-level rows or an export.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Record creation and updates
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Accounts, dues, charges, receipts, remittance sources, vendors, invoices and tax records are prepared under a prepare duty. Preparation is separate from approval and execution.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Delegation and substitution
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: A financial duty cannot be delegated. A permanent change goes through succession and revocation. A temporary absence has no specified path.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Confidentiality and privileged records
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Financial personal data, banking fields and member-level rows are separate grants. External accounting export is a separate duty-checked action. Platform billing is not union finance.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Financial or administrative approvals
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: View, prepare, approve, execute, reconcile and audit stay separate duties. Whether one principal may hold two is decided by a separation rule evaluated against the actual transaction. No real mandate, payment or export is authorized.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Audit and accountability
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Financial evidence, the audit trail, auditor and trustee duties and reconciliation are specified. A capability that is unavailable never reports success.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Notifications and workflow transitions
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Arrears follow-up is the only notification specified. Approval, execution and reconciliation name workflow states without a notification rule.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Revocation, termination and historical access
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: Succession and revocation, the mandate oversight view and the audit access that survives a mandate are specified. Revocation ends the duty on the next request and keeps the historical record.

visibilityWorkflowMatrix.label: Cross-persona handoffs
visibilityWorkflowMatrix.summary: The WorkAid boundary holds no referral power for the Financial Officer. Member financial records meet representation only through explicit denials and the audit trail.

negativeSecurityAndTenantIsolationCriter.statement: In a synthetic two-organization fixture, a mandate holder in organization A cannot view, prepare, approve or export an account, charge, receipt or report of organization B.
A principal with a finance, treasurer or officer role title and no live mandate performs no financial action and sees no financial navigation.
Where an institution has adopted a separation rule, the same principal is refused both halves of the protected pair on the same transaction, and the refusal names the rule.
Nzila platform billing and entitlement confer no union financial authority and are never offered as a union finance destination.
A view duty does not carry a report, member-level rows or an export. Each is checked as its own duty and field grant.
A capability that is NOT_IMPLEMENTED or answers HTTP 501 never reports success, and its navigation entry is not advertised as usable.
No real financial mandate is issued and no real payment, payment rail or external accounting export is executed from any test or fixture.
After a mandate is revoked or succeeded, the holder’s next request is refused and the historical record stays.
A financial duty cannot be delegated or lent, and an attempt is refused and audited.

A mandate holder in a local, region or national office gains no view of, and no duty over, another organization’s finances from the organization hierarchy. Cross-organization finance scope exists only as an issued instrument (DEC-PD-0C2-07).

sourceGaps.statement: UE-FINANCIAL-OFFICER-CANONICAL-2.1 is cited as FROZEN (design only) and exists in no ref. The package is a reconstruction candidate and is not that document.

Of the 38 historical identifiers, four carry their own title or status, six carry only group labels and twenty-eight have no individual meaning in any source. F01 to F28 meanings are new design under a historical status or group.
No source describes any organization’s finance structure. The four organization scenarios are hypotheses. The existing finance page is Nzila platform billing and is not union finance.

The navigation and several domain contracts have no implementation capability. Their completion owner is the Financial Officer tracking capability UE-OMIT-FINANCE-RANGE-UNSPECIFIED until a finance capability exists.

productApprovalDoesNot: Issue, approve or activate any of the 79 outstanding institutional decisions or the 32 baseline institutional authority decisions.
Issue a financial mandate, a triage designation, a supervisory mandate, a delegation, an appointment or any other instrument.
Create, name or fill an institutional office, including a steward office.
Change an implementation status, a security status, a release disposition or a runtime qualification status.
